english.meaning: to pay attention and watch out
english.note: Often negated: 一個唔留神 means one careless moment.

exampleSentences.english: This road is damn tricky. Wow, so many dogs—and landmines too. One careless step and you’re caught.
exampleSentences.traditional: 好鬼死邪𡃉唧哩條路。咦咁鬼多狗啊，又多地雷喎。嘩即係一個唔留神，一踩咪中招。
